that is why Iran is still at it today. ## Scriptures Opened **[Isaiah 19:4-10](/bible/isaiah/19#v4)** *[[16:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1vtxrpoLjyM&t=1012s)]* > [4](/bible/isaiah/19#v4) And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, the Lord of hosts. > > [5](/bible/isaiah/19#v5) And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up. > > [6](/bible/isaiah/19#v6) And they shall turn the rivers far away; and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: the reeds and flags shall wither. > > [7](/bible/isaiah/19#v7) The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no more. > > [8](/bible/isaiah/19#v8) The fishers also shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish. > > [9](/bible/isaiah/19#v9) Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded. > > [10](/bible/isaiah/19#v10) And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof, all that make sluices and ponds for fish. - The cruel lord over Egypt was Nebuchadnezzar, but it is written without a name because it is the fierce king of this fourth kingdom today. - The waters fail, the rivers are turned far away and the sluices and ponds are broken: the waterways are being affected now with Iran holding the Strait of Hormuz, and Gingrich wants to nuke a new canal through friendly territory. **[Ezekiel 35:1-10](/bible/ezekiel/35#v1)** *[[30:36](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1vtxrpoLjyM&t=1836s)]* > [1](/bible/ezekiel/35#v1) Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying, > > [2](/bible/ezekiel/35#v2) Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it, > > [3](/bible/ezekiel/35#v3) And say unto it, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, O mount Seir, I am against thee, and I will stretch out mine hand against thee, and I will make thee most desolate. > > [4](/bible/ezekiel/35#v4) I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate, and thou shalt know that I am the Lord. > > [5](/bible/ezekiel/35#v5) Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end: > > [6](/bible/ezekiel/35#v6) Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord God, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee. > > [7](/bible/ezekiel/35#v7) Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate, and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth. > > [8](/bible/ezekiel/35#v8) And I will fill his mountains with his slain men: in thy hills, and in thy valleys, and in all thy rivers, shall they fall that are slain with the sword. > > [9](/bible/ezekiel/35#v9) I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return: and ye shall know that I am the Lord. > > [10](/bible/ezekiel/35#v10) Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas the Lord was there: - Mount Seir is Esau, Edom, who dwelt there; the Arabs, the Nabataeans, hold it as Petra today, but the prophecy is against Esau, not the Arabs. - A perpetual hatred that sheds Israel's blood in the time that their iniquity had an end: when the emancipation proclamation came, Esau came behind with the Klan, Jim Crow and the black codes, bombed and flooded our homes and lives in our properties today. for they shall heap dust, and take it. > > [11](/bible/habakkuk/1#v11) Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power unto his god. - From 1492 they scoffed at kings and princes and derided every stronghold; they heaped dust, confusion, which is religion, and took it. - Then his mind changed to the democratic white man who is nice to the conquered, still offending, imputing his power unto his god: a god with a small g who is not the God of the Bible, though he has fooled the world. **[Daniel 11:36-39](/bible/daniel/11#v36)** *[[1:06:03](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1vtxrpoLjyM&t=3963s)]* > [36](/bible/daniel/11#v36) And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvellous things against the God of gods, and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that that is determined shall be done. > > [37](/bible/daniel/11#v37) Neither shall he regard the God of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god: for he shall magnify himself above all. > > [38](/bible/daniel/11#v38) But in his estate shall he honour the God of forces: and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things. > > [39](/bible/daniel/11#v39) Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory: and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain. - The king exalts himself above every god and speaks marvellous things against the God of gods: Greece did it, Rome did it and America does it.
